### New in 1.5.0
- **Shelf Styles (🪵 Shelf style)**: Customize what your shelves are made of! Choose from Glass, Wood, Iron, or Plastic materials. Features realistic timber wood grains, brushed metallic steel with rivets, glossy candy plastics, and translucent frosted glass across all shelves in Home and My Library.
- **Companion Pets (🐾 Pets)**: Choose your companion pet (Cat, Dog, Rabbit, Bird, or No pet) complete with custom sound effects! Your pet roams across screens, hops onto shelves on the Home page, naps and grooms, and hops up onto each to-do item on the To-do page to perform playful naughty antics. Double-tap your pet anytime to shoo it away!
- **Decorate This Shelf**: Enhanced shelf decoration dialog featuring hanging lights (warm white or multicolor glowing string lights), 18 interactive decorations, and 8 collectible stickers you can place and tear off your shelves.
- **About Readers & Creator Spotlight**: Updated About section welcoming readers to their reading sanctuary and honoring Creator & Lead Developer R Rajkumar Padmanabhan.

### Install / update
Download `shelfwise.apk` below and open it. It installs over older versions and keeps everything.
